import pandas as pd
file_path = '/data/seva_invoice_register_uncalculated.xlsx'
df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Invoice Register', header=3)
mask = df['Invoice ID'].astype(str).str.startswith('SEVA-25-')
subset = df[mask].copy()
# Compute line amount
subset['LineAmount'] = subset['Quantity'] * subset['Unit Rate (INR)']
total = subset['LineAmount'].sum()
print("Number of invoices:", len(subset))
print("Total spend:", total)
# Also check for any missing values
print(subset[subset['Quantity'].isna() | subset['Unit Rate (INR)'].isna()])

import pandas as pd
file_path = '/data/seva_invoice_register_uncalculated.xlsx'
df = pd.read_excel(file_path, sheet_name='Invoice Register', header=3)
mask = df['Invoice ID'].astype(str).str.startswith('SEVA-25-')
subset = df[mask].copy()
subset['LineAmount'] = subset['Quantity'] * subset['Unit Rate (INR)']
# Derive month from Expense Date
subset['Month'] = pd.to_datetime(subset['Expense Date']).dt.to_period('M').astype(str)
monthly = subset.groupby('Month')['LineAmount'].sum()
print(monthly)
print(monthly.sum())
